items.headline: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China

confirmed_facts.text: Concerns are being raised that neither the Commerce Department nor Nvidia are doing their due diligence when it comes to vetting Chinese firms cleared to handle the company’s H200 AI chips.

confirmed_facts.text: At the nearby property management agency for the industrial park, a receptionist and a manager both said they had no record of the company.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: At the nearby property management agency for the industrial park, a receptionist and a manager both said they had no record of the company.

confirmed_facts.text: And according to the Times, this is not a rare lapse in oversight, but a troubling pattern of companies connected to entities with national-security-related trade restrictions being approved to purchase Nvidia chips.
